frequency_question: How often do established U.S. Treasury or Federal Reserve secondary market intervention programs reach or exceed designated operational scale targets prior to program expiration or modification?
membership_rule: Includes major liquidity, buyback, or open market operations initiated by the U.S. Treasury or Federal Reserve with explicit quantitative operational volume targets. Excludes ad-hoc rescue facilities with no pre-announced structural volume trajectory.
coverage_note: 4 named major historical precedents spanning modern quantitative debt management programs.
known_gaps: Buyback programs specifically of this exact structure are novel, requiring reliance on broader Fed/Treasury open market operations data.
skeleton: Total structured Treasury/Fed operational expansions meeting targets divided by total announced major intervention programs in the modern era.
multiplier: 3 hits / 4 total documented major operational scale-up programs
validity_reason: Based on structural institutional behavior of the U.S. Treasury and Federal Reserve over decades, which changes slowly.
